We need to find template that when applied to the protected alcohol (TMS ether) gives back the alcohol (retro). The input molecule is the protected one? The earlier "make_5_lvl2-apply_template-3" gave precursors for applying template to molecule below, answer: [['CCC(O)CC', 'CCCC(=O)OC(CC)CC']]. That suggests the target molecule (protected?) was something else. Actually they gave two precursors: 'CCC(O)CC' (the alcohol) and 'CCCC(=O)OC(CC)CC' (maybe TMSOTf? No that's an ester). Hmm.

The task: return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below (provided as available input data), reproduces the reaction: TMSOTf protects alcohols. So we need to find template that does protection (forward) but we are doing retrosynthetic step: from protected alcohol to alcohol + TMSOTf? The input data from previous step gave precursors: alcohol and some other molecule (maybe TMSOTf). So the template should map protected alcohol to those two precursors. The protected alcohol SMILES likely is "CCC(O[Si](C)(C)C)CC". That's the protected version of "CCC(O)CC". The other precursor is "CCCC(=O)OC(CC)CC" which is maybe TMSOTf? Actually TMSOTf is trimethylsilyl trifluoromethanesulfonate: SMILES "C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F". Not the given. So maybe the other is a protecting group reagent? Not sure.

But we need to find template that when applied to protected alcohol yields those precursors. We attempted applying template 22133 (which is a silylation template) but got no result. Need to find correct template ID. Search for templates with retro_smarts that involve [C:2]-[OH] to C-[Si]... The template 22133 has retro_smarts: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]'. That's forward: alcohol to silyl ether. Retro would be silyl ether to alcohol. So applying to protected molecule should give alcohol. But apply_template returned empty, maybe because the SMILES didn't match due to missing something like O[Si] pattern? Our SMILES "CCC(O[Si](C)(C)C)CC" matches? Should. Maybe need to include explicit H? Try with "CCC(O[Si](C)(C)C)CC". Already used. Could be that template expects O attached to Si with O;H0? Should match. Maybe need to use template_id numeric not string. Use integer 22133.
